ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var raw = vars.parameters.connectionNumber --- if (raw is Array) (raw[0] as String) else (raw as String)
%dw 2.0 output application/json var body = if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload var result = body.result default [] --- sizeOf(result) > 0

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var body = if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload var result = body.result default [] var docs = if (result is Array) result else if ((result is Object) and !isEmpty(result)) [result] else [] --- { codeResponse: body.codigo default "200", responseMessage: "The request was successful", thirdParty: docs map (item) -> { connectionNumber: item.Numero_Conexion default "", modificationDate: item.Fecha_Modificacion default null, subscribers: (item.Lista_Abonados default []) map (a) -> { chargingCycle: a.Ciclo_Charging default "", subscriptionDate: a.Fecha_Subscripcion default null, connectionNumber: a.Numero_Conexion default "", product: a.Producto default null } } }

ee:transform.doc:name: Build find parent for duplicate check

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var body = if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload var result = body.result default [] var docs = if (result is Array) result else if ((result is Object) and !isEmpty(result)) [result] else [] var abonados = if (sizeOf(docs) > 0) (docs[0].Lista_Abonados default []) else [] var referred = vars.inputPayload.referredConnectionNumber as String --- sizeOf(abonados filter ((a) -> (a.Numero_Conexion as String) == referred)) > 0

when.expression: #[(vars.abonadosCount default 0) as Number < (vars.pasaGigasMax default 0) as Number]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- payload.result[0].Dia_Recarga_Recursos as String default null

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var padre = vars.inputPayload.connectionNumber default "" var maxPermitidos = vars.pasaGigasMax default 0 --- { status: "409", code: "HTTP:CONFLICT", message: "Parent " ++ padre ++ " already has the maximum referred subscribers. Allowed: " ++ (maxPermitidos as String), messageServer: "", cause: [{ origin: "business-papi-services-v2", message: "pasaGigasBeneficiaryQuantity limit reached" }] }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var padre = vars.inputPayload.connectionNumber default "" var abonado = vars.inputPayload.referredConnectionNumber default "" --- { status: "409", code: "HTTP:CONFLICT", message: "Referred connectionNumber " ++ abonado ++ " already exists for parent " ++ padre, messageServer: "", cause: [{ origin: "business-papi-services-v2", message: "Subscriber already registered in Lista_Abonados" }] }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var result = payload.result --- sizeOf(result) > 0
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- (payload.result[0].Value default 0) as Number default 0
